request: Make the Korean-copy variant of this product's README motion film, set in Pretendard, with the same treatment and the same drawn scenes.
pathReason: The film draws an OpenCode prompt, a toast, three locked permissions, a step chain and a recap, so it needs shapes and a drawn subject beyond type.
idea: One small word grows huge, shrinks into a typed prompt, lights a workflow, proves the planner can only read, leaves a written record and lets a fresh session carry on.
audience: Developers who already use OpenCode and are deciding whether a workflow plugin is worth adding.
channel: The top of the LitOpenCode GitHub page, played inline and opened as an MP4.
formatReason: A README hero sits in a wide column and the cover above it is 16:9.

beats.purpose: Distinctive hook: the smallest possible instruction, one word.
beats.onScreen: Ink background with generous empty space. A giant lowercase lit in cream fills the right half with the dot of the i drawn as a separate ember circle. On the left the large cream line 한 단어를 붙이세요. and the small LitOpenCode name at top left.
beats.motion: The dot pulses once with a spring. The headline words rise from a mask. In the last second the giant lit scales down and glides toward the left end of a prompt line while the headline lifts away.
beats.sound: a soft pad enters; a rise builds into the cut

beats.purpose: The word lands in a prompt.
beats.onScreen: A dark OpenCode pane fills the right side and the shrunken word settles as the ember lit at the start of a prompt line, then the rest of a to-do-list request types after it. Halfway through, the headline 워크플로가 켜집니다. rises in on the left.
beats.motion: Scale hand-off from the giant word into the prompt; the pane grows with a decelerating ease; the prompt types at a steady pace with a caret.
beats.sound: hit on the cut as the pane arrives

beats.onScreen: An ember-edged toast drops from the top of the pane with a flame mark and the words LIT IGNITED and lit-loop. Headline: 워크플로가 켜집니다.
beats.motion: The toast lands with one overshoot and settles; headline words rise from a mask one beat before it.
beats.sound: hit as the toast lands on the cut

beats.onScreen: An ember line sweeps across the pane and the contents change to the lit-plan name with three large rows, edit, bash and task, each with an open padlock. Headline: 계획 에이전트는 읽기만 합니다.
beats.motion: The sweep wipes the old contents to the right; rows rise in order; headline words rise from a mask.
beats.sound: a rise toward the first lock

beats.purpose: Trust: every write path is locked.
beats.onScreen: The three padlocks close one after another and an ember deny pill appears on each row while the rows tint ember. The headline holds.
beats.motion: Each lock snaps shut with a small spring shake, spaced about half a second apart, then a long readable hold.
beats.sound: hit as the first lock closes on the cut

beats.purpose: Continuity: every step is written down.
beats.onScreen: Four large nodes on a line, Plan, Build, Verify and Next, fill in lime one by one as the line draws across. Under them the project folder name litgoal/ appears in lime. Headline: 모든 단계가 기록으로 남습니다.
beats.motion: An ember line sweeps the contents away; the line draws with easing; each node fills with a small overshoot; the last node stays an open ember play mark.
beats.sound: hit on the cut; a rise toward the recap

beats.purpose: A new session picks the record up.
beats.onScreen: The pane is clean with a blinking caret. The recap command /lit-recap is typed, then three rows appear: Done and Checked with lime ticks and Next step with an ember play mark. Headline: 멈춘 곳에서 이어가세요.
beats.motion: An ember line sweeps the contents away; typing; rows rise in order and hold.
beats.sound: hit on the cut as the new session opens

beats.purpose: Resolve: the brand line and the returning ember dot.
beats.onScreen: The pane shrinks to a point that lands as the ember dot of the i in lit. Keep the work lit. sets centred in large cream type with the small LitOpenCode name under it. Long calm hold.
beats.motion: The pane contracts into the dot; the line reveals from a mask; the corner name glides to the centre; the dot pulses once.
beats.sound: cadence that resolves on the final chord and rings out

subject.name: One prompt inside OpenCode
specifics: A person adds the word lit to a request and LitOpenCode picks a workflow, announcing it with a toast.
The lit-plan agent has edit, bash and task denied, so it can only read and plan.
Progress is written to .litopencode/litgoal/ in the project, and /lit-recap reads it in the next session.

typePlan.hierarchy: Pretendard 700 for the headline and the giant lit, size and colour carry the hierarchy, one ember accent word per line; Pretendard 400 for the small name; MesloLGS NF only inside the drawn terminal pane, where a real terminal is monospace. Korean lines are set at a smaller size than the English ones, with no tracking or width animation.

palette.role: ink background shared with the cover
ember accent for lit, the toast and denied
lime, used only for recorded and verified

sound.plan: A clear glass-toned pad in D minor at 92 BPM with a light tick on each beat, a rise into the first cut, a hit as the pane and each later scene arrive, and a resolving final chord under the closing line.

inventions: The subject name, One prompt inside OpenCode, and its three specifics, taken from the README's documented behaviour.
The whole subject, a single prompt session, and every copy line except the typed prompt and the product name are written for this film from the README's documented behaviour.
The pane, toast, locks, step chain and recap rows are drawn illustrations of what the documentation describes, not screen captures.
The Korean headline wording, written for this film.
ambition: Type as the set: a giant word that shrinks into the prompt so the film never cuts, only hands off; one headline and one drawn idea per beat with generous empty space; slow deliberate eases with one overshoot on the ignition and lock events; a final ember dot that returns as the i of lit.
